title: X-linked novel hemizygous ADGRG2 variants associated with male factor infertility.
authors: Yuan, Yuwei; Li, Yong; Lu, Wenqing; Peng, Zhendong; Deng, Lei; Lin, Xinle; Liu, Lin; Meng, Lanlan; Tan, Chen; Lin, Ge; Zhang, Qianjun; Tan, Yue-Qiu; Zhang, Huan; He, Wenbin; Li, Huanzhu; Hu, Liang; Tu, Chaofeng
journal: Journal of assisted reproduction and genetics
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全外显子测序鉴定ADGRG2基因变异并利用AlphaFold预测突变蛋白结构，但核心是男性不育的临床遗传学研究，蛋白质结构预测仅作为辅助验证，缺乏计算建模方法创新。
abstract: PURPOSE: To screen for ADGRG2 gene mutations in CFTR-negative patients with male infertility or congenital bilateral absence of the vas deferens (CBAVD), and to assess the feasibility and outcomes of intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) for achieving successful pregnancies in this population. METHODS: Whole-exome sequencing (WES) was performed in 133 infertile men with obstructive azoospermia (OA). Sanger sequencing were conducted on peripheral blood samples collected from nine patients with ADGRG2 variants. The AlphaFold database and PyMOL software were used to predict the 3D structure of the mutant ADGRG2 protein. In vitro assays were conducted to assess the functional impact of the identified ADGRG2 variants. In addition, we also conducted a retrospective analysis of the clinical assisted reproductive information of these patients. RESULTS: We identified eight ADGRG2 hemizygous pathogenic variants in nine unrelated patients with CBAVD from 133 OA men: one splicing variant (c.1839 + 1G > A), three frameshift variants (c.2956_2957del: p.M986Vfs*2; c.2396dupT: p.L799Ffs*18 and c.895delA: p.I299Ffs*12), two nonsense variants (c.2473C > T: p.R825* and c.2971G > T: p.E991*), and two missense variants (c.510G > C: p.E170D and c.549C > G: p.S183R). All ADGRG2 variants-affected individuals presented with azoospermia or severe oligozoospermia. All of these variants were absent or rare in public databases. 3D protein structure modeling predicted that ADGRG2 variants lead to alterations in the spatial conformation of the protein. In vitro experiments further confirmed that these variants result in the production of truncated proteins or reduced protein levels. Notably, four patients undergoing ICSI treatment achieved successful fertilization and pregnancy. CONCLUSION: Our findings established ADGRG2 variants cause male infertility and may be the etiology of CBAVD, expanding the associated mutational spectrum and reinforcing the gene's critical role in male fertility, thereby supporting the integration of comprehensive ADGRG2 screening into clinical practice to enhance genetic and reproductive counseling for affected patients.
abstract_zh: 目的：在CFTR阴性的男性不育或先天性双侧输精管缺如（CBAVD）患者中筛查ADGRG2基因突变，并评估该人群通过卵胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）实现成功妊娠的可行性与结局。方法：对133例梗阻性无精子症（OA）不育男性进行全外显子组测序（WES）。对9例携带ADGRG2变异的患者采集外周血样本进行Sanger测序。利用AlphaFold数据库和PyMOL软件预测突变型ADGRG2蛋白的三维结构。通过体外实验评估所鉴定ADGRG2变异的功能影响。此外，我们还对这些患者的临床辅助生殖信息进行了回顾性分析。结果：在133例OA男性中，我们于9例无亲缘关系的CBAVD患者中鉴定出8种ADGRG2半合子致病性变异：1种剪接变异（c.1839 + 1G > A）、3种移码变异（c.2956_2957del: p.M986Vfs*2；c.2396dupT: p.L799Ffs*18和c.895delA: p.I299Ffs*12）、2种无义变异（c.2473C > T: p.R825*和c.2971G > T: p.E991*）以及2种错义变异（c.510G > C: p.E170D和c.549C > G: p.S183R）。所有受ADGRG2变异影响的个体均表现为无精子症或严重少精子症。所有这些变异在公共数据库中均缺失或罕见。三维蛋白结构建模预测ADGRG2变异导致蛋白空间构象改变。体外实验进一步证实这些变异导致截短蛋白的产生或蛋白水平降低。值得注意的是，4例接受ICSI治疗的患者实现了成功受精和妊娠。结论：我们的研究结果确立了ADGRG2变异导致男性不育，并可能是CBAVD的病因，扩展了相关突变谱系，并强化了该基因在男性生育中的关键作用，从而支持将全面的ADGRG2筛查纳入临床实践，以增强受影响患者的遗传和生殖咨询。
